Backend Developer at DataForge

Responsibilities
- Design and build REST APIs.
- Implement authentication and authorization.
- Optimize SQL queries and database schemas.

Required Qualifications
- Must have strong experience with Node.js.
- Must have experience designing REST APIs.
- Proficiency with SQL and PostgreSQL is required.
- Experience implementing authentication (OAuth, JWT).

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Redis.
- Experience with message queues such as Kafka.
